name: Hermes Agent
summary: Open-source agent runtime from Nous Research with a built-in learning loop (skills from experience), agent-curated memory, 40+ tools plus MCP, and a multi-platform gateway (Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, CLI).

agent-runtime.note: Agent loop with subagent spawning, skill learning, and 300+ LLMs via multiple providers.

orchestration.note: Cron scheduler for unattended automations and parallel subagents; no declarative DAG/workflow engine.

knowledge-memory.note: Agent-curated memory, persistent user profiles, cross-session recall, and full-text search over past conversations.

tools-integration.note: 40+ built-in tools, MCP server support, and seven terminal/sandbox backends.

identity-governance.note: Single-operator model; no multi-tenant IAM, policies, quotas, approvals, or audit log.

observability.note: Batch trajectory generation and research-focused evaluation tooling; no structured trace/usage/audit model.

data-secrets.note: No managed file storage or encrypted secrets store.

evaluation.note: Batch trajectory generation for model training and research eval tools; not a dataset/scorer eval product.

channels.note: Single gateway to Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, and CLI with cross-platform conversation continuity.

code-execution.note: Seven terminal backends: local, Docker, SSH, Singularity, Modal, Daytona, and Vercel Sandbox.
